nodes.description: Ownable.owner - privileged address checked by the onlyOwner modifier
Ownable.owneraddress - secondary owner mirror, zeroed by renounceOwnership
mapping(address=>bool) _feeExcluded - addresses flagged as fee-free
mapping(address=>uint256) balances - token balance ledger
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) allowed - ERC20 allowance ledger
uniV2router - Uniswap V2 router address stored at construction
uniV2factory - Uniswap V2 factory address stored at construction
fees - global boolean fee switch toggled by applyFees
name - token name string
symbol - token symbol string
_balances - hardcoded 1e24 constant mistakenly used as a balance in burnFrom
decimals - token decimals (9)
totalSupply - minted/burned supply counter
burnPercentage - settable rate, never used by any logic path
telegramAddress - social link string returned by TelegramLink
Ownable constructor - assigns owner/owneraddress from msg.sender
ownerAddress() view - returns owneraddress
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner - zeroes owneraddress but never clears owner
EtherKirby constructor - mints supply to msg.sender and stores router/factory
balanceOf(address) view - reads balances mapping
includeFee(address) onlyOwner - sets _feeExcluded[addr]=false
excludeFee(address) onlyOwner - sets _feeExcluded[addr]=true
feeExcluded(address) view - reads the fee-exclusion flag
applyFees() onlyOwner - toggles the global fees boolean
feesState() view - returns the fees switch
transfer(address,uint256) - forwards msg.sender into private _transfer
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) - moves tokens and decrements allowance
approve(address,uint256) - writes the allowance of msg.sender, no zero-first pattern
allowance(address,address) view - reads the allowed mapping
burnFrom(address,uint256) onlyOwner - burns supply and corrupts the wrong balance entry
newFeePercentage(uint8) onlyOwner - writes burnPercentage
_transfer(address,address,uint256) private - core balance mutation and fee gating
TelegramLink() view - returns telegramAddress
msg.sender - caller-controlled address used for ownership, minting and transfers
burnFrom writes balances[account] = _balances.sub(amount), debiting the fixed constant instead of the account's real balance
_transfer requires fees == false for excluded addresses and fees == true otherwise, reverting legitimate transfers
_transfer treats _from == owner || _to == owner as an unconditional fee/transfer bypass branch
router - Uniswap router address passed to the EtherKirby constructor
factory - Uniswap factory address passed to the EtherKirby constructor
_totalSupply - mint amount passed to the EtherKirby constructor
_owner - address queried by balanceOf
_address - account re-enabled for fees by includeFee
_address - account exempted from fees by excludeFee
_address - account queried by feeExcluded
newRate - replacement value written into burnPercentage
_to - transfer recipient
_value - transfer amount
_from - debited account of transferFrom
_to - credited account of transferFrom
_value - amount moved and allowance decremented by transferFrom
_spender - allowance beneficiary in approve
_value - allowance amount set by approve
_owner - owner side of the allowance query
_spender - spender side of the allowance query
account - target of burnFrom and the address whose balance is wrongly debited
amount - burn quantity subtracted from totalSupply and the hidden _balances constant
_from - source address of the internal _transfer
_to - destination address of the internal _transfer
_value - amount moved by the internal _transfer
msgSender - local cache of msg.sender inside the Ownable constructor
balance - named return value of balanceOf

factory is only consumed by the EtherKirby constructor where it is stored in uniV2factory
_totalSupply is only consumed by the EtherKirby constructor for minting
_owner is only used to index balances in balanceOf

_address is only used to index the _feeExcluded mapping in excludeFee
_address is only used to read the _feeExcluded flag in feeExcluded
newRate is only written into burnPercentage by newFeePercentage
_to is only forwarded to _transfer by transfer
_value is only forwarded to _transfer by transfer
_from is used by transferFrom for the debit and the allowance update
_to is only forwarded to _transfer by transferFrom
_value is forwarded to _transfer and subtracted from the allowance by transferFrom
